title:
Switch Renderer for Bulk Model Configuration Modal used to display different UI Grids based on different conditions.

Return values:
- `showSelectedModels`: Not implemented yet
- `showSelectedCVS`: Not implemented yet
- `showSelectedAssets`: Returned when {@link BulkModelConfigApplicationState#isSensorAssociationFlow} is `true`.
- `default`: Whenever the other conditions are not met this is the default value. (Renders the Selected Datasets Grid).
name: BulkModelConfigSelectedEntitiesSwitchRenderer
